subject: ct_vhm_foot

entries.note: Heel to 115 mm along the foot axis (calcaneus, talus, navicular, cuboid, cuneiforms unseparated).

The DU release carries the metatarsals and phalanges of this body at higher quality (bbox agreement with this CT within 5 mm); only the tarsals ship from the CT, because the DU 'tarsals' is a single 45 mm bone (talus-sized) and the CT has the whole tarsus including the calcaneus.
